gloss: to join; to become a member; to subscribe

definitions.gloss: to join; to become a member; to subscribe
definitions.explanation: To officially become part of an organization, group, plan, or service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加入|かにゅう}する。
⟦{組合|くみあい}→組合：02669_kumiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加入|かにゅう}することにした。
examples.english: I decided to join the union.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加入|かにゅう}した。
examples.english: This country joined the international organization last year.

notes:
Used for formally joining organizations, subscribing to services, or entering agreements. The particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks the group or service being joined. The noun form ⟦{加入|かにゅう}→加入：11915_kanyuu⟧ is commonly used on its own, especially in compound phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加入|かにゅう}する: to take out insurance
- ⟦{組合|くみあい}→組合：02669_kumiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加入|かにゅう}する: to join a union
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}→加入：11915_kanyuu⟧: new enrollment
- ⟦{加入|かにゅう}{者|しゃ}→加入者：22913_kanyuusha⟧: subscriber; member
- ⟦{加入|かにゅう}→加入：11915_kanyuu⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: enrollment procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入会|にゅうかい}する→入会する：19522_nyuukaisuru⟧: to join (a club or association) — used for clubs, gyms, and membership-based groups, while {加入|かにゅう}する is broader and includes insurance, unions, and international bodies
- ⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to participate — focuses on taking part in an event or activity, not becoming a formal member
